usage:
A common noun for a university as a place of higher education. Use it when talking about studying, applying, or working at a university.
• It often appears after verbs like 讀, 入, 畢業, or 去. In casual speech, people also say 上大學 to mean "go to university".
• In Hong Kong Cantonese, 大學 can refer to the institution itself or the university life/stage of study. It is very neutral and widely used.
• For a specific school name, put the name before 大學, e.g. a university name + 大學. Keep the word order natural in Cantonese.

Common noun for higher education institution.
• Often used with study and campus-related verbs.
• Neutral, everyday word in Hong Kong Cantonese.
• Can mean the institution or the university period.
